MAHANADI COALFIELDS ANNOUNCES RS 8,981 CRORE IPO PRICE BAND

Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields will launch its Rs 8,981 crore initial public offering on 19 November 2026. The price band is fixed at Rs 129-136 per share, with a lot size of 110 shares.

For information only. Not investment advice.

#MahanadiCoalfields #CoalIndia #IPO #IPONews #StockMarketIndia
